preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of edges m must be between n-1 and the minimum of n*(n-1)/2 and 200,000.
The value of k must be between 1 and the minimum of n*(n-1)/2 and 400.

postconditions.description: The output must be the k-th smallest shortest path length from the sorted list of all shortest paths.
